sequence.objective: Read the old core husk before touching any residue.
Settle the residue silt until it shows what can safely enter.
Understand the scar lock as protection, not a door.
Warm the inheritance seed remnant without opening it.
Only the settled silt trace may enter. The husk, scar, and seed stay intact.

safeTransfer.objectBehavior: silt trace enters while the old husk, scar lock, and inheritance seed remain visibly respected

worldFacingRead.start: The Grave will not feed you until you understand what is buried here.
worldFacingRead.husk: Pulse the husk; read the unfinished becoming without claiming it.
worldFacingRead.silt: Settle the silt. It carries trace memory, not treasure.
worldFacingRead.scar: The scar lock is protecting memory, not hiding a door.
worldFacingRead.seed: Warm the inheritance seed. Do not open it yet.
worldFacingRead.transferReady: Only the settled silt trace is safe to receive. Hold absorb gently near it.
worldFacingRead.complete: The Grave has given a trace, not a reward. Let the remains settle; exit readiness is only being prepared, not opened.

allowedScope: target focus rule for Grave objects
one safe silt memory transfer after reading
acceptanceTests: The loop activates only in CELL_GRAVE_MEMORY_RESIDUE_BED_001 after the Grave arrival readability system is active.
Pulse/proximity reading must advance husk, silt, scar lock, and seed remnant understanding before any safe transfer is possible.
Holding absorb before the sequence is ready must be refused with read-before-absorb messaging.
Only residue_silt_cloud_001 may complete a safe memory-silt transfer in this pass.
The old core husk, scar lock plate, and inheritance seed remnant must not be consumed or hidden by HC-004F.
No combat, dialogue tree, quest log, gate, door, teleport, branch menu, stage-node loader, old exit registry, or Act expansion is added.
